title: Artificial Intelligence in Deliberation: The AI Penalty and the Emergence of a New Deliberative Divide
reasoning: The paper is a political science survey experiment focusing on public willingness to participate in AI-moderated deliberation and perceptions of its quality. While it briefly mentions human perceptions of AI's capacity for morals and ethics as part of an anthropomorphism scale, it does not evaluate or benchmark moral, ethical, or religious systems within the AI itself.
